[[Olympique de Marseille]] won '''Division 1 season 1971/1972''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 56 points.

* [[RC Strasbourg]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group C
